In this USA travel vlog, we visit the city of San Francisco, California. We needed to find a good and cheap place to sleep for the night near San Francisco. Luckily, we got a FREE night in San Francisco by discovering a useful VANLIFE hack - we parked in a free overnight spot and got the ferry into the city the next morning. This was the cheapest option we were able to find and we had no problems parking overnight in SanFran, at a place called Sausalito, overlooking the skyline of the city across the water. 
After getting the ferry across to San Francisco the next morning, we visited the famous Pier 39 to watch the sea lions which turned out to be an excellent way to start the day! Followed by going to our first real American Diner where we tried french toast, drenched in maple syrup and washed down with a cup of joe!

After leaving SanFran, our American Road Trip dream comes to an end. Thanks to everyone who's joined our adventure - please subscribe to watch more of our content in the UK, Europe and beyond! And hit that notification bell to be notified of future content coming soon! 🔔
